desc:
🌲 **PROWL — PHASE TWO IS UNDERWAY** 🌲

Phase One is coming to a close, and **Prowl is officially moving into Phase Two development.**

We’re making great progress behind the scenes, including work on **new character models and visual improvements** that will continue to shape the world of Prowl.

⚠️ **The new models are not released yet.**

### 🐺Paid Access

As Prowl continues to grow, returning to Paid Access allows us to continue supporting the development of the game while we work toward the next phase.

Every player who joins helps make it possible to keep improving the world, creating new content, refining existing systems, and bringing the next generation of Prowl models and features to life.

There is **no official release date for Phase Two yet**, but development is progressing **faster than originally expected**, and we’re excited about the direction things are heading.
